description: Get all transfer partners for a loyalty currency with transfer ratios. Returns the static partner map — no active bonus data. Use to check if a specific airline/hotel program is reachable from a bank currency.

program.description: Alias for `source` — same behavior. If both are provided, `source` takes precedence.

source.description: Source program key (e.g., 'amex_mr', 'chase_ur', 'citi_typ'). Alias: use `program` instead if more intuitive.

name: get_transfer_partners
